quotes.q: To be the best, you must learn from the best.
Your journey is uniquely your own, and any transformation or growth you experience is the result of your own choices and actions.
My goal is to awaken you, to take you out of your trance, to have you become aware of who you truly are.
I'm attracting success based on these time tested proven principles.
I'm taking control of my life and I am able to manifest any wish or desire in my personal and professional life.
Take advantage of what you have now in your hands.
Whatever your dreams are, whatever dreams you have, you can make them come true.
Successful people are always willing to do what the other guys are not willing to do.
Successful people are always doing what the other guys are still talking about.
If you listen to the wrong person, you could get the wrong directions and never get to your destination.
What one person has done, you can do also.
It's your desires and your wishes that are important, not other people's.
There's no right or wrong when it comes to desires or dreams.
Successful people are not people without problems. They are people who've learned how to overcome their problems.
Listen to someone who has what you want and has been where you are.
We have to make sure we're listening to the right people.
Reading is something that is really overlooked and undervalued.
If you want things in your life to change, you're going to have to change things in your life.
They're willing to give up something good to get something great.
They understand they have to put in first before they can take out.
The way you have been thinking has to change.
You can't do the same actions as you did in the past if you want different results.
If you aren't teachable, you are not growing. If you aren't growing, you're dying.
You never stay at the place you're at. You're always either going forward or backwards.
Believe in your receive, doubt and go without.
Work on getting all this knowledge into your DNA. Make it a part of you.
It is not when you get this book, but rather when this book gets in you.
You can be the captain of your own ship, a nuclear powered vessel with unlimited power.
So learn what you did wrong and correct it the next time.
Your vision or dream board is a powerful ingredient in the manifesting recipe.
It is not what you have acquired, but it is who you become that is truly important.
Not being attached to things will keep you free.
Integrity, honesty, character, love, forgiveness, compassion, giving, generosity, appreciation, gratefulness and understanding are what it's really all about.
Have a dream, but don't live in a dream world.
Take control of your feelings with your willpower by acting as if.
Focus on what you want, not what you don't want.

_note: 20 Nov 2026: famous sayings by other authors (Hill, Ford, proverbs), duplicates and fragments removed - only Kevin's own lines.
